Title: Architecture: Documentation Site Structure
Content:
The documentation site follows a standard docs-site architecture:

Global Components:
- Navbar: Top navigation with logo, nav links, search
- Footer: Site footer with links and copyright
- DocLayout: Two-column layout with sidebar navigation + content area (for user docs)
- DeveloperLayout: Two-column layout with sidebar navigation + content area (for developer docs)

Features:
- home: Landing page with hero, feature highlights, CTA sections
- docs: User-facing documentation pages organized by topic
  - Getting Started
  - .NET Development
  - Angular Development (cyrena.angular extension — prerequisites, folder structure, workflow)
  - Arduino IDE
  - PlatformIO
  - UI Overview
  - API References — explains .aiapi export/import, shippable AI memory
- developer: Developer documentation for building on/extending the platform
  - DeveloperLanding: Overview page with cards linking to developer topics
  - DeveloperLayout: Sidebar layout for developer docs
  - CyrenaCore: Documentation for Cyrena.Core NuGet package (contracts, models, options, extension methods)
  - CyrenaPersistenceCore: Documentation for Cyrena.Persistence.Core NuGet package (IStore<T>, ICyrenaPersistenceBuilder, extension methods)
  - CyrenaExtensaCore: Documentation for Cyrena.Extensa.Core NuGet package (IExtension, ExtensionInfo, Dependency, loading process)
  - CyrenaComponentsCore: Documentation for Cyrena.Components.Core NuGet package (IDisplayService, IShortcut, IToolbarComponent, KernelComponentBase, ComponentOptions, CodeLanguages, shared Blazor components)
  - CyrenaCodingCore: Documentation for Cyrena.Coding.Core NuGet package (ICodeBuilder, IDevelopPlanService, IVersionControl, DevelopPlan, DevelopItem, DevelopFile, DevelopFileContent, DevelopFileLines, DevelopFolder, DevelopFileVersion, StickyNote, DevelopFileExtensions, DevelopFolderExtensions, DevelopOptions, class hierarchy, quick start)
  - ExtensionDevelopment: Comprehensive guide to building Cyréna extensions
- extensions: Extension showcase/catalog (NOT documentation)
  - ExtensionsLanding: Grid/catalog of available extensions
  - ExtensionDetail: Individual extension info page with metadata from Packages API
  - ExtensionDataService: HTTP client for Packages Consumer API
  - Models: Package, PackageVersion interfaces

Removed pages (no longer linked in nav):
- Core Concepts
- API Reference (old standalone page)
- Guides
- FAQ

Routing:
- /#/: Home/landing
- /#/extensions: Extensions catalog/landing
- /#/extensions/:packageId: Individual extension detail page
- /#/docs: Docs landing (user docs)
- /#/docs/getting-started
- /#/docs/dotnet
- /#/docs/angular
- /#/docs/arduino
- /#/docs/platformio
- /#/docs/ui-overview
- /#/docs/api-references
- /#/developer: Developer docs landing
- /#/developer/core: Cyrena.Core package documentation
- /#/developer/persistence: Cyrena.Persistence.Core package documentation
- /#/developer/extensa: Cyrena.Extensa.Core package documentation
- /#/developer/components: Cyrena.Components.Core package documentation
- /#/developer/coding: Cyrena.Coding.Core package documentation
- /#/developer/extensions: Extension development guide

All components use OnPush change detection, signals for state, and input()/output() for communication.
